data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, MAJOR — SUPERSEDES paths in original ACs): (1) TEST PATH: the behavioral test is tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh (repo-root tests/ tree; create the tests/implementation-plan/ subdir). The script itself stays at plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh. Update all AC Verify: commands referencing plugins/dso/tests/... accordingly. (2) TARGET_SYMBOL CONTRACT: pin the script's invocation contract — it takes the target symbol as an argument, e.g. 'migration-class-detect.sh <target_symbol> [<lang>] [<repo_root>]'. When no target symbol can be determined, emit migration-class=inconclusive (never crash). Document this argv contract in the script header and assert it in the test. (3) The key read for the threshold is migration.call_site_threshold (see task-1 amendment).
